lovejoy.x: Thanks for calling LoveJoy Hormone Clinic, I'm Ellie, an AI assistant on a recorded line. You can talk to me like a normal person. How can I help you today?
I'd like to get started as a new patient.
Great. Can you spell your first and last name?
So that's [[16]], right?
Yep. That's right.
Can I use the number you're calling from?
Yeah. That's fine.
Okay. And what's your date of birth?
And just for the chart, male or female?
Female.
Do you prefer we call you back in the morning or afternoon?
Afternoon works.
And how did you hear about LoveJoy?
I found it on Google.
Have you ever had hormone therapy before?
No, I haven't.
And what made you reach out to LoveJoy?
I've been having hot flashes and trouble sleeping for about six months, plus low energy.

Okay, I'll let the team know about the hot flashes, trouble sleeping, and low energy. What kind of treatment are you interested in? Like pellets, injections, or creams? Or if you're not sure yet, that's totally fine.
I'm interested in pellets and maybe cream. I'd just like to learn a bit more about my options.
That's totally fine. The team can walk you through all the options and answer your questions when they call. Is there anything else you'd like them to know before they reach out?
I work nights, so afternoons are best.
You're all set. Our team will reach out to get your lab appointment booked. Is there anything else I can help you with?
Thanks. Bye.
Thanks for calling LoveJoy. Take care.

merx.x: Merx Truck and Trailer Repair shop, this is Chet. Who am I speaking with?
Chet, this is Eddie. I was wondering, did I leave a message with you in regards to an engine? A QX60?
Hey Eddie, let me see. Are you calling about a vehicle that's already in the shop, or do you need to schedule a new service?
I was wondering about a vehicle to have a service scheduled.
Gotcha. Let me get your info. Spell your name for me please.
E D D I E. V as in Victor, A N C E.
Thanks Eddie. And what's the vehicle make and model?
All right. What kind of service are you looking for?
I'm looking for a remanufactured engine.
Gotcha. Just so you know, we only use components we source, to guarantee the quality of our work. So bringing your own parts like a remanufactured engine won't be possible.
Will you be able to source a remanufactured engine? The phasers on it go out once they get over a certain mileage, and it's got four phasers and a myriad of timing chains.

I hear you, Eddie. We do source parts for repairs, but I can't promise specifics on the engine. Drop it off any time Monday to Friday, eight to five, and Mark the service advisor will take care of it. Is this the best number to reach you at?
When you source it, could you call me back to let me know if you can locate a remanufactured engine?
Gotcha, Eddie. I'll have Mark the service advisor call you back as soon as they can. About the cost, we need to look at it first to give an accurate quote. Sound good?
That sounds good. That completes my concern.
All right, Eddie, thanks for calling. Have a good one and take care out there.

Picture this, Jason. It's late, you're buried in paperwork, chasing forms, handling payments, all while supporting grieving families. At this rate you'll need a funeral for your free time. That's where Funeral Buddy comes in. Would you be against seeing how it works?
I wouldn't be, but it sounds a lot like the software that we already use.

Fair call, Jason. A lot of funeral homes say the same thing until they see how Funeral Buddy is built specifically for independent directors like yourself. I'll lock in a quick 15 minute demo. What day and time works best for you, mate?
I could do Monday, sort of between 8:30 and 9:30, somewhere around there.
Let me just check if we've got a spot available for Monday morning. All right Jason, the closest available time we've got is Tuesday at 9am. Would that work for you?
It wouldn't. I'll be out of town on Tuesday. So probably maybe Wednesday.
Let me check Wednesday morning. Looks like Wednesday's booked out too, Jason. The next available time is Thursday at 9am. Would that suit you, mate?
Yeah, I think that would work.
Perfect. I've booked you for a demo of Funeral Buddy on Thursday at 9am, and I'll send the confirmation to your email. Does that sound correct?
Perfect. You'll get confirmation shortly. Thanks for your time, Jason.
